title: Strict henselization preserves regular local rings
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local commutative ring and $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ its strict henselization with respect to a separable closure of its residue field. Then $R$ is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme] if and only if $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ is a regular local ring.

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LN (lemma-henselization-regular), equivalence of the first and third conditions

proof.text: The strict henselization is Noetherian because $R$ is Noetherian, by [lem-sc-strict-henselization-noetherian]. Thus the regular-local criterion applies to both $R$ and $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$.
The strict henselization has the same Krull dimension as $R$, by [lem-sc-strict-henselization-dimension].

By [lem-sc-strict-henselization-cotangent-dimension], the cotangent spaces of $R$ and $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ have equal dimensions after identifying the residue-field extension. Applying [lem-weil-pbc-regular-local-cotangent-dimension] to the two Noetherian local rings, regularity is equivalent in each case to equality of Krull dimension with cotangent-space dimension. The equalities from Steps 1 and 2 therefore give $R$ regular if and only if $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ regular.
